name: Game Boy Interface
author: Extrems
description_short: Free alternative to the Game Boy Player Start-up Disc
description_long: Game Boy Interface (GBI) is a free replacement for Nintendo's Game Boy Player Start-up Disc, available in three editions: Standard, Speedrunning, and High-Fidelity. Features faithful emulation of the handheld experience, GBA-as-controller via the Game Boy Advance Cable, a built-in GBA ROM/BIOS/save dumper, and TAS movie playback.
